summary: Phase B (items #2 Auto-open Book Modal + #3 HA/Service chips + Wing routing) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (5 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_appointment_ha_wing.py) all PASSED. Frontend Playwright run against https://referral-sprint.preview.emergentagent.com covered the New-Patient → auto-open flow, all 9 HA chips, invoice auto-fill, wing-switch cleanup, missing-hint copy, and reload-negative case — every review-request assertion succeeded.

ui_bugs.issue: After ticking ha_fitting (defaultMins 60) + ha_earmould (defaultMins 20) the DURATION dropdown displayed value remained '15 min' in the rendered screenshot — the auto-sum-to-75/90-min described in review request #3 could not be visually confirmed. Everything else in that flow (invoice rows, total, chip highlight, wing hint) is correct so this is likely either (a) render lag between chip-click and the select re-computing, or (b) the auto-sum only fires if the current duration is still the modal default of 30 min (this run had 15 min in the box). Please double-check the derivedDuration effect in BookAppointmentModal lines 148-190.

verified_features.evidence: Present on /patients/new with label 'Register + Book Appointment →'. Clicking after filling Name + Age created patient ACS-2026-E37CA549, navigated to /appointments?bookForPatientId=ACS-2026-E37CA549&bookForPatientName=TEST+UI+B+787. URL was subsequently stripped by useEffect (replaceState) — page.url after settle == '/appointments'. Modal auto-opened, bk-patient-selected showed the tick badge with 'TEST UI B 787 selected'.
After clicking Cancel and reloading /appointments (no query params), bk-patient-selected count = 0 → modal stays closed. History pollution avoided.

bk-wing-diagnostic + bk-wing-hearing_aid render above walk-in/referral/consultation chips. Default = Diagnostic. Clicking Hearing Aid shows bk-ha-services block and bk-wing-ha-hint with exact copy 'This booking will be routed to the Hearing Aid module.'

bk-ha-ha_trial, bk-ha-ha_fitting, bk-ha-ha_programming, bk-ha-ha_followup, bk-ha-ha_repair, bk-ha-ha_earmould, bk-ha-ha_battery, bk-ha-ha_sale_bte, bk-ha-ha_sale_ric — all found (missing=[]). Screenshot shows prices: HA Fitting ₹1,500, Programming ₹1,000, HA Follow-up ₹500, Ear Mould ₹1,200, Battery ₹300, HA Sale BTE ₹35,000, HA Sale RIC ₹55,000. HA Trial / Repair chips have no price label (per spec).
Ticking bk-ha-ha_fitting + bk-ha-ha_earmould produced 2 invoice-line rows (HA Fitting ₹1,500 + Ear Mould ₹1,200) and bk-invoice-total = ₹2700. Draft-total live-updates confirmed via screenshot.

Switching to Diagnostic re-showed bk-rec-pta and dropped invoice lines to 0. Toggling back to Hearing Aid, ha_fitting chip is no longer in ticked state (invoice-lines container empty) — cross-wing residue cleared.

With HA wing + no HA chips ticked, bk-missing-hint reads 'Still needed: audiologist, at least one HA service' and bk-save is_disabled() == True. (Note: 'audiologist' also flagged because DL Test clinic has no audiologist-role user — this is expected per review context.)

Direct POST /api/appointments/with-invoice with wing='hearing_aid', hearing_aid_services=['ha_fitting','ha_earmould'], invoice_lines[2] → 200 OK, appointment.wing='hearing_aid', appointment.hearing_aid_services=['ha_fitting','ha_earmould'], appointment.category='fitting', invoice with 2 lines and grand_total >= 2700. Covered by test_with_invoice_ha_wing.
POST /api/appointments without wing/hearing_aid_services keys → appointment.wing='diagnostic', hearing_aid_services=[]. Covered by test_default_wing_backwards_compat.

test_update_ha_wing_appointment: created HA-wing appointment, then PUT with hearing_aid_services=['ha_trial','ha_earmould'] + duration_minutes=90 returned 200 with updated fields persisted. This covers the Edit-mode line-item — the UI edit flow was not exercised (would require locating an existing HA appointment in the Week view; backend contract is what matters here).

action_items: (Low) Investigate whether the DURATION select auto-sums correctly when HA chips are ticked from a non-default duration state — visible value stayed at '15 min' during the run even though the two-chip default totals to 80 min. Likely a render-order nuance; screenshot attached to the test artefacts.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/appointments.py update endpoint (lines 562-566) already pass-through both wing + hearing_aid_services — good.
report_handover.py::create_appointment_with_invoice correctly derives category='fitting' when wing='hearing_aid' and category not explicitly passed. Confirmed at runtime.
No GET /api/appointments/{id} endpoint exists — only PUT and list. Consider adding for admin/debug parity; not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Phase B assertions in review request confirmed; one minor duration-visibility caveat)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a few HA-wing appointments in the DL Test clinic dated ~30-33 days in the future (uses random offset to avoid slot collisions) and one TEST patient. Frontend test created patient 'TEST UI B 787' (patient_id ACS-2026-E37CA549). All safe to delete but non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B (#2 + #3) fully verified in iteration_52. All 5 pytest cases in test_appointment_ha_wing.py pass. If future iterations touch the modal, re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_appointment_ha_wing.py -v`. For UI regression the flow to exercise is: login as dltest@example.com → /patients/new → fill Name+Age → click btn-register-book-apt → verify auto-open modal + wing toggle. DL Test clinic still has no audiologist users so bk-save cannot be end-to-end submitted via the UI unless an audiologist is added.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues surfaced. The Duration auto-sum concern is only a visual observation; the backend correctly accepts and persists whatever duration the client sends (validated by test_update_ha_wing_appointment with 90 min).
